admission.justification: A responding application is alive even while it draws the selected chat. This turns slow host work into another document load and disables later message switches.

alternatives.option: Probe readiness/request lateness and reload only after unanswered ping.
alternatives.reason: A responding application is alive even while it draws the selected chat.

alternatives.option: Reload at the first missing answer deadline.
alternatives.reason: This turns slow host work into another document load and disables later message switches.
alternatives.reconsider_when: If the application cannot answer responsiveness probes independently of the missing open answer.

consequences: Explicit Retry, host return and unsupported-open URL steering stay distinct.
context: The earlier controller treated ten-second answer lateness as channel loss.
decider: Architect 97e0320d on the developer requirements, accepted by the Manager in the L140 decision log

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "loads the frame once when the application answers nothing at all, and switches by message again", "asks by a ping at the deadline and loads nothing: the application answers with its late ready report" / "… its pong", "counts the channel as unavailable only when that ping stays unanswered too, and then loads nothing more"; dashboard/src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx › "keeps the frame, shows the banner after an unanswered ping, and shows executions by URL"
